<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS peak at m/z 179.0946, the most plausible neutral mass (assuming a protonated ion) is ~178.087 Da. The formula C7H14O5 matches this mass within a few millidaltons and is consistent with the observed isotopic pattern, so the molecular formula is C7H14O5.</thought>
<final_answer>C7H14O5</final_answer>
